title: Coordination between 5GSM and ESM without N26 interface

entities.name: Inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode
entities.description: Procedure for transferring PDU sessions from 5GS to EPS when N26 interface is not supported. The UE creates PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST messages based on PDU session parameters.

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Procedure for transferring PDN connections from EPS to 5GS when N26 interface is not supported. The UE creates PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST messages based on EPS bearer context parameters.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: ESM message used by UE to request PDN connectivity during inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode. Contains mapped parameters from PDU sessions.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: 5GSM message used by UE to establish PDU sessions during inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode. Contains mapped parameters from PDN connections.

entities.name: Protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: Information element that carries PDU session identity and ATSSS request parameters during inter-system change procedures.

entities.name: PDU session identity
entities.description: Identifier allocated by UE for PDN connections to enable transfer to 5GS. Stored in Protocol configuration options IE.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management idle state during which inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode occurs.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE
entities.description: 5G Mobility Management idle state during which inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode occurs.

entities.name: No N26 interface support
entities.description: Condition where network does not support N26 interface, requiring UE to perform parameter mapping and local session management during inter-system changes.

entities.name: Local session release
entities.description: UE behavior to locally release PDU sessions/PDN connections and associated resources that are not transferred during inter-system change.

relations.description: UE creates PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message during inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode
UE creates PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message during inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains Protocol configuration options IE with PDU session identity
Inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode occurs when UE is in EMM-IDLE state
Inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode occurs when UE is in 5GMM-IDLE state
When N26 interface is not supported, UE performs local release of sessions not transferred during inter-system change
Protocol configuration options IE contains PDU session identity parameter
